Extract and score candidate search terms from enriched seed papers

Source: R/04_term_extraction.R
extract_candidate_terms.Rd

Extract and score candidate search terms from enriched seed papers

Usage

extract_candidate_terms(
  seeds_df,
  config = list(),
  max_candidates = 50L,
  probe_pubmed = TRUE,
  eval_bg_fn = NULL,
  email = NULL,
  ncbi_key = NULL,
  cache_dir = ".cache",
  use_cache = TRUE,
  progress_cb = NULL
)

Arguments

seeds_df

Enriched tibble from `enrich_seeds()`.

config

Optional config list (`banned_terms`, `required_terms`, `custom_blocks`).

max_candidates

Max terms to probe against PubMed background frequency.

probe_pubmed

Logical; whether to probe PubMed for background `bg_hits`.

eval_bg_fn

Optional function `(term) -> integer` for testing without network.

email

Optional email for NCBI polite pool.

ncbi_key

Optional NCBI API key.

cache_dir

Cache directory path.

use_cache

Logical; whether to read/write cache.

progress_cb

Optional progress callback function.

Value

Tibble of scored candidate terms with `cov_tiab` and `cov_title` list-columns.
